sla: Citizen Charter Service Standard: 9 working days (Section 2.3, 'New Water Connection' row). No separate Right to Service Act entry exists for this specific service (see description).
complaint_channel: Municipal Corporation Office, Water Supply Branch / Engineering Branch (O&M), Moti Bagh, Patiala-147001
contact_information: Designated officer chain for new connections (per Section 2.3 table): Clerk (Meter Reader) -> Junior Engineer -> Executive Engineer. Exact phone number not individually listed for this service in the source document.
